"Hit That" is a song by American rock band the Offspring, included as the fourth track on the band's seventh studio album, Splinter (2003), and was released as its first single.
The song also appears as the 13th track on their Greatest Hits (2005).
"Hit That" was released to US rock radio on November 3, 2003.
Splinter is the seventh studio album by American punk rock band the Offspring, released on December 9, 2003, by Columbia Records.
It was the first album the band released without long-time drummer Ron Welty, who was fired three weeks before the recording sessions started.
Although not as successful as the Offspring's previous albums, Splinter received gold certification two months after its release.
